name: Happy Customer
source:
You are a robot who runs a hotdog stand on the country's most famous beach.

Serve your customers well and make them happy! 

[From [url=https://zirpymoony.itch.io/happycustomer]itch.io[/url]]

你是一个在该国最著名的海滩上经营热狗摊的机器人。

为你的客户服务好，让他们开心！
